correctness.rationale: Integral relative cellular LES for the pair (K_m×K_m,Y) has just E diagonal squares in relative degree two; graph triangles abc and abd for c≠d outside each edge ab give a ±unit image in the coordinatewise cycle-product map. Thus its integral cokernel vanishes, the kernel is free, and ranks are 2b and b²-E with no higher cells. Oriented-edge and vertex traces yield p; the Koszul minus flip and the relative edge-permutation module yield the remaining rational character formulas. Actual verifier code was run from its standalone path, and all 1728 symmetry cases and modular chain-rank checks pass for m=4,5,6. No finite test is used as a proof of all m.

value.rationale: A natural and nontrivial all-size family K_m has an explicit integral homology classification and a full commuting vertex-permutation/label-swap character, with a structural Λ² cycle-module summand. The two distinguished collision conventions differ in H2 already for K5 (26 versus 1), clarifying what vertex sinks change. Surjectivity of the cycle-product map is a sharp graph-geometric mechanism requiring m≥4; neither an arbitrary parameter slice nor a mere restatement of a published rank table.
